messages:
Asha (GTM): quick follow from today's all-hands on partner GTM. Need short answers so I can make a single-slide exec summary.
Maya (Sales): go for it.
Asha (GTM): 1) leadership wants guidance: do we offer partner pilot credits with revenue share clauses, or stick to simple credits + co-marketing? pros/cons in one line pls.
Maya (Sales): credits + co-marketing preferred. revenue share adds negotiation overhead and delays pilots.
Diego (Partnerships): agree with Maya. revenue share for strategic tier but not for early pilots. keeps ops light.
Priya (CEO): prioritize speed to pilot. revenue share only for multi-quarter, high-touch deals.
Asha (GTM): 2) marketplace listing cadence: can we soft-list partners this quarter without billing integration?
Nina (Product): yes — toggle on partner visibility in 2 sprints. Billing/SKU integration is separate (4 sprints).
Jules (RevOps): soft-listing needs a canonical partner display name mapping for reports. I'll own that.
Asha (GTM): 3) attribution in usage exports: leadership wants partner_id and partner_tier fields for weekly ops. effort?
Nina (Product): small ETL change to persist X-Partner-Id and add tier mapping. estimate 1 sprint eng + 1 analytics sprint.
Jules (RevOps): once available I'll surface partner-tiered funnel cards in the ops digest.
Asha (GTM): 4) routing: partners sending referrals -> AE or SDR? proposed rule: referrals with partner_score >= 9 and est_ARR >= 40k -> AE direct; else SDR. quick thumbs?
Diego (Partnerships): thumbs up. add AE-calendar-check fallback to prevent assignments to unavailable reps.
Maya (Sales): add SLA: AE first-touch <= 36h for AE-routed referrals.
Asha (GTM): 5) pilot readiness checklist for exec slide: what are the 5 must-haves? one phrase each.
Sam (Legal): data handling summary.
Diego (Partnerships): integration POC plan.
Maya (Sales): go-to-market/co-marketing commitment.
Nina (Product): sandbox with production-like latency.
Jules (RevOps): attribution & reporting wired.
Asha (GTM): Action items: Diego -> draft pilot slide + contact list (due Tue EOD). Jules -> partner display name map + dashboard card placeholder (Thu). Nina -> schedule ETL change (confirm sprint by Mon). Sam -> fast-track SOC2 checklist path (48h). Maya -> update playbook with SLA & revenue-share guidance.
ops-bot: Reminder set: partner ops summary -> #partners every Monday 9:00am PT.
Priya (CEO): thanks team. keep slide to one page.
Maya (Sales): will do.
